result.summary: Several visual problems: a broken/missing restaurant image placeholder, truncated restaurant names, a partially cut-off category chip, and incomplete bottom card content.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows only a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of a food photo.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant image or provide a proper fallback illustration so the card is not empty.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters at the end of the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap, use a smaller font, or truncate with an ellipsis so the full name remains readable.

issues.description: The category filter chips overflow the screen; the chip after 'Healthy' is cut off on the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling works smoothly and that partial chips are not clipped without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: The pizza promo card at the bottom is heavily cropped, showing only the top of the image with little context.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card height or image crop so more of the dish and any associated text/CTA remain visible above the tab bar.
